slides.title: In the EU, women earn 48% of PhDs but hold 30% of full professorships
slides.source: Source: European Commission, She Figures 2024, Fig. 6.1 (EU-27, 2019 and 2022). Grade A = full professor; grade C = entry-level post-PhD.

slides.title: In France, women's share of university professors doubled since 2000 but is still 33%
bullets: Women are **45%** of maîtres de conférences but **33%** of professors (2024)
Professors: 17% women in 2000, 23% in 2010
CNRS: women are 34.7% of researchers and **31.7%** of directeurs de recherche (2022)
Inserm: 66% of PhD students are women, 26% of the top research-director grade
slides.source: Sources: MESR, Vers l'égalité femmes-hommes ? Chiffres clés 2026, p. 36-40; CNRS Plan d'action égalité 2024-2026, p. 5; Inserm, Journée Inserm 2024 (parité).

slides.title: Women leave publishing science at a 19.5% higher yearly rate than men
bullets: Publication careers of 1.5 million scientists, 1955-2010
Yearly dropout: **10.8%** of women vs **9.0%** of men
Women's careers are shorter, so their lifetime output is lower
If dropout is equalized, the productivity gap shrinks from **27% to 9%**
slides.source: Source: Huang, Gates, Sinatra & Barabási (2020) PNAS 117:4609, Fig. 4. doi:10.1073/pnas.1914221117

slides.title: US women faculty are more likely than men to leave at every rank
bullets: Each year, women are **6%, 10% and 19%** more likely to leave as assistant, associate and full professors
Promotion rates are lower for women at the same seniority
Women more often report being **pushed out** by workplace climate, not pulled to better jobs
slides.source: Source: Spoon, LaBerge, Wapman et al. (2023) Science Advances 9:eadi2205, Fig. 1 (A attrition, B promotion). doi:10.1126/sciadv.adi2205

slides.title: Equal attrition alone will not bring US faculty to parity by 2060
bullets: Women: **46%** of US doctorates (2021), **36%** of tenure-track faculty
In 90% of fields, hiring shaped women's representation more than attrition (2011-2020)
Removing the attrition gap gives only a marginal gain
Parity needs sustained changes to **hiring**
slides.source: Source: LaBerge, Wapman, Clauset & Larremore (2024) eLife 13:RP93755, Fig. 3 (OA observed attrition, GNA gender-neutral attrition, IR/ER increasing/equal hiring). 268,769 faculty.
